scope: Batch 6 only; explicit user assignment overrides taskbook old priority

assets.label: 扇形刀光
assets.subject: A clean right-facing fan-shaped sword slash of ivory-white light edged in pale steel blue. Four phases: short curved leading streak, wide full 100-degree fan sweeping clockwise, thin trailing crescent, sparse separated fading slash fragments. Transparent interior, no sword, no character. Fixed central pivot. Non-looping.

assets.label: 落雷
assets.subject: One tall narrow branching lightning bolt striking vertically down to a small impact point, electric ice blue and white. Four phases: thin leader, thick brilliant branched strike, narrower rebound with small sparks, short residual branches. No cloud, no ground or scenery. All share bottom impact anchor.

assets.label: 符文飞弹
assets.subject: A compact right-facing golden magical projectile, one angular geometric sigil inside an amber core, small golden sparks trailing to the left. Four looping phases with subtly different flickering trails, same core shape and center. No lettering.

assets.label: 冰锥
assets.subject: A single long pointed faceted ice projectile facing exactly right, asymmetrical crystal facets in icy blue, white upper-left edge and slate-blue underside, clear sharp tip. No trail or sparkles.

assets.label: 诡火光环
assets.subject: A circular magical fire aura viewed from directly overhead, ring of discrete emerald and turquoise ghost flames with transparent empty center. Four phases cycling flame tongues clockwise. Same circle diameter, clear perimeter, restrained dark teal outer edging. No floor, no character.

assets.label: 羽刃
assets.subject: A single sharp wing-feather shaped magical blade pointed exactly right, tapered ivory feather vanes, one golden central quill, steel-gray lower edge. Clear feather silhouette and sharp pointed tip, no glow cloud, no bird.

assets.label: 霜冻冲击波环
assets.subject: An expanding frost shockwave ring directly overhead. Four phases at 30,55,80,110 logical pixel diameter, same exact center. Hollow center truly transparent. Narrow broken icy-blue ring edged in small sharp ice chips, icy white leading edge. Single ring only per frame. No floor or scenery.

assets.label: 冰柱
assets.subject: One jagged faceted ice pillar rising from a fixed low crystal foot. Four phases at 15,30,43,57 logical pixels tall, same fixed bottom baseline and unchanged pillar width, growing upward, same blue-white crystal facets. No eruption ground or loose cloud.

assets.label: 经验宝石
assets.subject: A single tiny blue faceted diamond-shaped experience gem. Readable at only 16x16 pixels, body 10x12 pixels maximum. Four clean large facets, brilliant upper-left cyan highlight, medium sapphire blue and dark blue lower edge. No jewelry mount, no sparkles.

assets.label: 大经验宝石
assets.subject: A single golden faceted diamond-shaped experience gem, large reward variant. Readable at only 24x24 pixels, body 16x19 pixels maximum. Six broad simple facets, pale gold upper-left highlight, amber side facets, dark bronze lower edge. No jewelry mount, no sparkles.

assets.label: 宝箱关闭
assets.subject: A small closed medieval northern wooden treasure chest, front three-quarter view facing right, dark weathered wooden boards bound by desaturated brass straps, one clear square brass clasp, rounded lid, small compact body about 25x22 logical pixels. No treasure outside.

assets.label: 宝箱打开
assets.subject: The identical reference treasure chest, now with its lid opened upward, revealing a small pile of gold coins. Keep exact wooden base, brass straps, perspective, position and body width. Keep whole open lid inside canvas, no floating sparks, no new chest design.

assets.label: 光柱标记
assets.subject: A narrow vertical quest beacon: slender ivory-gold column rising from one small elliptical golden ring at the bottom. Four looping phases moving two or three angular light motes gently upward inside the pillar, column silhouette and ground ring remain fixed. Pixel clusters and solid discrete bands only, transparent gaps, no gradient fog or god figures.

assets.label: 篝火
assets.subject: A modest northern winter campfire, compact pile of crossed charred brown firewood and gray stone ring, warm amber and orange flame with pale yellow core. Four looping phases changing only flame tongues and a few ember pixels; firewood and stone base remain pixel-identical and grounded. No snow patch or ground scene.

assets.label: 渡鸦
assets.subject: A black raven hovering facing right, heavy beak and readable crow profile, restrained blue-gray highlights. Four coherent wingbeat phases: wings high, wings diagonal, wings low, wings diagonal back; one identical central body, beak, head and feet. Both wings anatomically correct, compact silhouette readable at 32x32. No perch or scenery.

assets.label: 死者指甲
assets.subject: One detached old human fingernail clipping as a tiny collectible, curved flattened tapering keratin plate, no finger or flesh. Desaturated ivory gray, dark gray outline and subtle pale-blue highlight. Clear curved nail shape at 16x16, body 9x10 pixels. No blood or sparkles.

assets.label: 铁火盆
assets.subject: A squat northern iron brazier with a dark riveted iron bowl on three short sturdy legs, warm amber coals and orange flames. Four looping phases change flame tongues only, identical iron structure and feet baseline in every frame. Side-front top-down game view, no ground plane.

assets.label: 太阳余烬
assets.subject: A small irregular charcoal-black ember containing a blazing golden-orange heart, hovering in place. Four subtle flicker phases, identical cracked stone shape and position, golden light peeking through 3 cracks and tiny separate amber sparks. No giant flame or sun face. Readable dark silhouette and hot center.

assets.label: 金色线团
assets.subject: A tiny round loose ball of GOLDEN yarn with 4 broad curved thread ridges and one short curled loose end pointing right. Pale golden top-left, amber-gold body, brown shadow. Readable small silhouette, actual final canvas 16x16, object 12x11 pixels.

assets.label: 银色线团
assets.subject: Identical tiny yarn ball as reference, SILVER color variant. Same round silhouette, broad thread ridges and one short right-facing curled loose end, identical geometry and camera. Cool blue-silver light, mid silver and dark steel shadows. Clearly metallic silver rather than flat white.

assets.label: 黑色线团
assets.subject: Identical tiny yarn ball as reference, BLACK color variant. Same round silhouette, broad thread ridges and short curled loose end pointing right, identical geometry and camera. Near-black body, cool slate-blue edge highlights bright enough against #121721 dark background. Avoid large white highlights or pale body.

assets.label: 白色线团
assets.subject: Identical tiny yarn ball as reference, WHITE color variant. Same round silhouette, broad thread ridges and short curled loose end pointing right, identical geometry and camera. Matte warm ivory-white body, cream light and gentle pale gray shadow, no metallic silver shine.

assets.label: 灰色线团
assets.subject: Identical tiny yarn ball as reference, GRAY color variant. Same round silhouette, broad thread ridges and short curled loose end pointing right, identical geometry and camera. Medium neutral gray body and lighter gray edge, clearly darker than silver or white but lighter than black.

assets.label: 祭司冰涡
assets.subject: An overhead cold blue ice vortex, three curved chunky crystalline arms spiraling clockwise around a small transparent center. Four evenly spaced rotation phases 0,30,60,90 degrees, same diameter, same blue-white colors and thickness. Broad sparse pixel shapes rather than dense snow noise. No floor or creature.

assets.label: 冰洞鱼竿
assets.subject: A small dark oval hole cut through blue lake ice, an uneven ice-white rim and a single simple bent wooden fishing rod stuck beside the hole to the right, thin fishing line going into the hole. Front/top-down game prop view. One 64x48 sprite, wide compact silhouette, no lake background or large snow patch.

assets.label: 巨人脚印
assets.subject: A SINGLE giant bare-foot imprint in snow, viewed overhead, heel at bottom and five distinct round toe depressions at top. Cold blue-gray sunken interior, thin lighter icy rim. One footprint only. Separate toes, broader than human foot, maximum body 20x26 pixels, no surrounding snow tile.

assets.label: 墓碑暗淡
assets.subject: One ancient rough northern tombstone of dark weathered slate, upright rounded-tapered rectangular stone, a few simple angular geometric incisions, small chips, subdued frosty blue-gray upper-left edge. No readable letters, no cross, no skull, no snow or ground patch. Clear 32x48 prop, about 24x42 pixels.

assets.label: 墓碑唤醒
assets.subject: The exact same reference tombstone, awakened: same stone contour and chips, incised angular geometric strokes now bright amber gold, small gold edge accents. Keep same stone size, position, dark gray rock color and base. No added halo, no new large ornament, no ground scene.

assets.label: 发光符文一
assets.subject: One floating glowing angular sigil resembling a vertical stave with two symmetrical diagonal upward branches. Original simple geometric mark, not readable alphabet text. Golden core with amber dark edge and only a few sparse gold sparks. Strong readable silhouette at32x32, no circle, no stone.

assets.label: 发光符文二
assets.subject: One floating glowing angular sigil formed from two opposing angular chevrons joined by a vertical spine. Original simple geometric mark, not readable alphabet text. Golden core with amber dark edge and a few sparse gold sparks. Strong readable silhouette at32x32, no circle, no stone.

assets.label: 发光符文三
assets.subject: One floating glowing angular sigil formed from an angular diamond with a vertical tail below. Original simple geometric mark, not readable alphabet text. Golden core with amber dark edge and a few sparse gold sparks. Strong readable silhouette at32x32, no circle, no stone.

assets.label: 冰封战士
assets.subject: One large translucent-looking but solid-pixel blue ice block, irregular faceted obelisk, with a dim trapped frost warrior silhouette inside. The warrior inside must match the uploaded frost giant's hunched body, broad shoulders, white fur, dark beard and stone armor, barely visible through blue crystal. Actual alpha fully opaque within ice, no see-through image opacity, no ground or surrounding shards.

assets.label: 英灵待机
assets.subject: A golden spectral northern warrior facing right, horned iron helmet, short beard, round shield on near arm and single straight sword on other hand, compact 48x48 full-body silhouette. Restrained pale gold, amber and bronze shading with dark warm outlines. Four very subtle idle breathing phases, all have same helmet, shield design, sword and body proportions, stable feet baseline. No aura, blade trails or scenery.

assets.label: 英灵攻击
assets.subject: Animate the identical golden spectral northern warrior from reference, facing right. Four sword attack poses: ready, raised backswing, forward rightward sword strike, recovery. Keep same horned helmet, short beard, round shield design on near arm, single sword in other hand, identical gold palette and body size. All frames fit48x48 including sword with margins, stable feet baseline. No trails or effects.
